title: Comprehensive Plan - Hampshire
short_description: Consulting services for a new comprehensive plan guiding Hampshire’s long-term growth and development.
project_scope: Preparation of a new comprehensive plan for the Village of Hampshire covering a 10-20 year horizon. Scope includes housing stock evaluation (unit types, lot sizes, affordability, gaps), land use inventory and zoning analysis, transportation and mobility conditions, infrastructure capacity (water, sewer, utilities, stormwater), and environmental constraints (floodplains, wetlands, watersheds).
services: Comprehensive planning and consulting services; land use and zoning analysis; transportation and mobility assessment; infrastructure capacity assessment; environmental constraints analysis.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a comprehensive/urban planning assignment, not a structural or engineering design project.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure is included.
- The tender focuses on planning policy, land use, housing, mobility, and infrastructure assessment.
- According to the exclusion notes, pure urban/open space planning and similar strategic planning services are not relevant for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice only states a total construction cost/budget of 125000 USD for the planning assignment.
